notes: Dungeon room situations for dungeons-2.json (Plan 6 D5, set 2): site situations with room: true, played only in a delve and never on the road or at an ordinary site. Ids start with their dungeon's id. DCs are written at standard difficulty (10-16); the engine rebases them to the dungeon's CR and doubles wounds. Climax rooms are high-stakes. Options that need a good spend it in every outcome. Written by Claude. A failed or critically failed room that ends the encounter drives the party out of the dungeon (no hoard; the site can be retried another time), so failure texts describe being driven back. The last room of each dungeon is a skill challenge sized by the dungeon's CR (3 successes before 2 failures up to CR 5, 4 before 3 up to CR 12, 5 before 3 above), whose win pays the hoard and whose loss drives the party out.

start.text: The coffins on their biers are gnawed through at the corners. As your light falls on them, a grey tide of rats pours out of the nearest and comes squealing across the flagstones.

fail.text: The rats run up legs and under cloaks. Everyone is bitten, and you flee the mausoleum.

partial.text: {actor} lays about until the swarm thins and flees, bitten for it.

success.text: {actor} kicks the leaders flat, and the rest pour back into the coffins.

options.label: Smoke them out (1 fuel)
options.description: A smouldering bundle sends them running. The fuel is spent either way.

fail.text: The smoke rolls the wrong way. You stumble back out, coughing, the rats nipping at your heels.

partial.text: The smoke drives most of them into the walls; a few bite on the way.

success.text: {actor} fans the smoke into the coffins, and the rats flee squealing into the dark.

fail.text: A coffin lid slides off with a crash, and the swarm is on {actor}. You run.

partial.text: Most of the swarm ignores you. A few follow, nipping.

success.text: You slip down the hall in single file, and the rats never stir.

start.text: One coffin lid sits askew, and something inside it rattles softly, like a fist of dice.

fail.text: A spring-loaded blade snaps out of the lid and opens {actor}'s arm. You go back out to bind it.

partial.text: {actor} finds the trap and the cause: a mourner's purse of loose coin, slipped in with the dead.

success.text: {actor} disarms a hidden blade and finds a mourner's purse and a pot of embalming balm.

options.label: Let the dead keep their things

outcome.text: You leave the lid where it lies. The rattling stops behind you.

start.text: Iron-bound chests are stacked against the far wall, behind a bronze seal set in the floor. The locks are old, and one has a needle-hole where a key should go.

fail.text: A needle jabs {actor}'s thumb. The poison is weak, but it leaves them too shaky to go on.

partial.text: {actor} opens one chest before the needle bites: grave linen, and a few coins.

success.text: {actor} draws the needles one by one. Inside, among the linen, is a small cache of coin.

fail.text: The lid snaps back on {actor}'s fingers, and the needle finds them too. You lead them out, sickening.

partial.text: The lock gives, spilling old linen and a little coin.

success.text: {actor} wrenches the hasps off in one heave. There is coin under the linen.

outcome.text: You leave the family's things to the family.

start.text: A grey woman kneels at the altar on the dais, as see-through as breath on a cold morning. She is weeping without a sound, and the air around her is bitter cold.

fail.text: She turns, and her grief pours into {actor} like cold water. You flee her wailing.

partial.text: She hears you, and fades with a long sigh.

success.text: {actor} asks her name and listens. She smiles, at last, and is gone, and the hall feels warmer.

options.label: Speak the rites for the dead

fail.text: The words only wake her anger, and the cold bites everyone and drives you from the tomb.

partial.text: She fades slowly, still weeping.

success.text: {actor} speaks the old rites, and she bows her head and goes to her rest.

outcome.text: You hurry past, and the cold of her grief settles in your bones.

start.text: Bones scrape in the burial niches along the walls. One by one, the dead of the family climb down, and turn their empty faces toward you.

fail.text: They are many and do not tire. You fall back out of the mausoleum, battered.

partial.text: You break them one by one, taking knocks.

success.text: {actor} smashes the first two, and the rest fall apart.

fail.text: They come on regardless, and {actor} is caught in the front. You are pushed back out the door.

partial.text: They hesitate, and you fight past the few that keep coming.

success.text: {actor} raises the symbol, and the dead fall back into their niches like dropped puppets.

start.text: The sarcophagus lid grinds aside. A gaunt thing in a rotten shroud sits up, the family circlet still on its brow, and its nails are long and black.

fail.text: Its claws rake {actor}, and the cold of them numbs to the bone.

partial.text: A long, ugly struggle at the lip of the tomb.

success.text: {actor} beats it back against its sarcophagus.

options.label: Speak its name and the burial rites
options.description: Name the dead, and it may remember it is dead. A bad prayer leaves you open.

fail.text: The words mean nothing to it. It lunges at the one who spoke.

partial.text: It hesitates at the words, then claws on.

success.text: {actor} speaks the founder's name. It stops, and turns its head as if to listen.

options.label: Chalk a ward round the tomb (1 arcana)
options.description: Easier, and the warding is spent either way.

fail.text: The ward is drawn crooked. It claws through, still tangled in the chalk.

partial.text: The ward holds it a moment, no more.

success.text: It slams against the ward and falls back, and you strike while it is caught.

win.text: The founder falls back into its sarcophagus and is still at last, the circlet rolling from its brow.

lose.text: Its claws and its cold drive you back along the passage and out of the crypt. Behind you the lid grinds shut.

start.text: Past the tipped ore cart, a cord is strung ankle-high across the adit, tied off to a prop that holds up a shelf of loose rock.

options.label: Find every wire before you go on

fail.text: {actor} misses the second wire. Rock comes down on them and seals the way, and you dig them out and turn back.

partial.text: {actor} finds two wires and steps on the third. A few stones fall.

success.text: {actor} finds three wires and cuts them all, and you go on in safety.

fail.text: Someone catches the wire. The rockfall bruises everyone, and you retreat.

partial.text: {actor} clears it, but brushes a second wire on landing.

success.text: You hop the wire one by one and are past.

start.text: A band of kobolds is stripping the abandoned cart for nails. They squeal, raise their spears, and look at you, then at their chief, then back at you.

fail.text: They fight like cornered rats and stab at everyone, and you are driven back up the shaft.

partial.text: They scatter after a sharp scuffle.

success.text: {actor} bowls over the chief, and the rest run.

fail.text: They are more scared of their chief than of you. The spears come at {actor}, and you back out of the mine.

partial.text: Half of them run. The rest put up a short fight.

success.text: {actor} bellows, and the kobolds flee squealing into the dark.

options.label: Toss them food (1 food)
options.description: Hungry scavengers rarely fight over a free meal.

fail.text: They take the food and stab anyway, and you run.

partial.text: They grab the food and back off, muttering.

success.text: They seize the food and bow you past, chattering happily.

start.text: The gallery is a long trench of still green water, cold as a winter well. A rowboat is tied at the foot of some plank steps, and there is a narrow, crumbling ledge along the wall.

fail.text: The boat ships water and rolls over. You swim back to the near shore, frozen.

partial.text: {actor} rows hard while the others bail. You arrive soaked to the knees.

success.text: {actor} rows smoothly to the far end, and the boat holds.

outcome.text: You shuffle along the crumbling ledge for an hour, backs to the wall, and arrive stiff and tired.

start.text: Halfway down the flooded gallery, the green water ripples. Leeches as long as an arm come humping out of it and up the ledge toward the warmth of you.

fail.text: They latch on and drink deep. You cut them away and stagger back out.

partial.text: {actor} cuts them away, but not before one feeds.

success.text: {actor} slashes the leeches back into the water.

options.label: Burn them off (1 alchemicals)
options.description: Leeches shrivel at a dusting of caustic salts.

fail.text: The powder sprays wide. The leeches still feed, and you flee the water.

partial.text: The leeches curl and drop off, all but one.

success.text: {actor} dusts the ledge with powder, and the leeches writhe back into the water.

start.text: The northern working ends in a heap of boulders and snapped pit-props, with a timber hoist leaning over it. Under the rocks you glimpse a miner's boot, and a pack.

fail.text: The heap shifts and a boulder rolls onto {actor}'s leg. You carry them back out.

partial.text: {actor} drags the pack out with bloodied hands: bandages, and a waterskin.

success.text: {actor} shores up the heap with a prop and pulls the pack free: bandages and good tools.

options.label: Shore it up first, then dig
options.description: Slow but safer. Costs a day.

fail.text: The props are rotten. A day's work, and the heap still comes down on {actor}. You give up the dig.

partial.text: Slow work. You get the pack out in the end.

success.text: Careful work, and the heap gives up the pack and the miner's tools.

outcome.text: You leave the miner under his stones.

start.text: A side cave where yellow-crusted ore lies heaped and the walls glitter. The air tastes of metal, and there is a dead bat on the floor.

options.label: Hold your breath and fill a sack
options.description: The ore is worth carrying out; the air is not good to breathe.

fail.text: The fumes get into {actor}. You all stagger out of the mine, sick and empty-handed.

partial.text: {actor} gets a sack half full before the fumes make them retch.

success.text: {actor} fills a sack with good ore and is out before the fumes bite.

outcome.text: You give the bad air a wide berth.

start.text: The props round the sinkhole are scraped raw. Something long and many-legged pours up over the edge, its mouth a bunch of twitching feelers, and the feelers reach for you.

fail.text: The feelers find {actor}, who goes stiff as a board.

partial.text: You hack it back over the edge, and get stung for it.

success.text: {actor} cuts away a fistful of feelers, and it reels back over the edge.

options.label: Fight it from the ladder
options.description: Only one of you can reach it, but it cannot reach the rest.

fail.text: {actor} slips on the rungs, and it catches them hanging.

partial.text: {actor} keeps above it, but cannot reach to strike.

success.text: {actor} climbs above its reach and stabs down. It twists to follow, its soft belly bare.

options.label: Lure it with meat (1 food)
options.description: Carrion eaters are easy to distract. The meat is gone either way.

fail.text: It ignores the meat and comes for whoever threw it.

partial.text: It snatches the meat and comes on, chewing.

success.text: It wraps itself round the meat, and you hack at it while it gulps.

win.text: It slides back into the sinkhole and does not climb out again. Far below, something heavy hits the water.

lose.text: It pours over the edge after you, and you scramble back up the shaft for daylight, dragging the stung.

start.text: The wreck lies on its side among fang-like rocks, its carved dragon prow reaching for the sand. The tide sucks in and out through a hole in the hull, and something in the hold gleams.

fail.text: A wave slams {actor} against the timbers, and they come out with nothing. You give up the cove for now.

partial.text: {actor} comes up gasping with a coil of good rope.

success.text: {actor} times the waves and comes out with rope, a lantern and a sealed bottle of spirits.

options.label: Leave the wreck to the sea

outcome.text: You leave the wreck to the waves and walk on up the beach.

start.text: The wreck's ribs are crawling. Crabs as broad as shields sidle out of the hull, claws raised, and cut you off from the beach.

fail.text: The claws close on legs and arms, and more shells keep coming. You retreat up the shore.

partial.text: {actor} cracks two before a claw takes hold.

success.text: {actor} flips the biggest on its back, and the rest scuttle into the surf.

options.label: Climb round them over the rocks

fail.text: {actor} slips on the weed into a waiting claw. You pull them free and fall back.

partial.text: You get round with skinned shins.

success.text: You pick a way over the rocks, and the crabs lose interest.

start.text: Stubs of black candles stand in the sand of the strand, freshly lit, though there are no footprints but yours. The flames lean toward the sea.

fail.text: {actor} bends too close. A cold wind off the water blows the candles out and the cold into you, and you flee the dark.

partial.text: {actor} guesses a vigil for the drowned. Someone still keeps it.

success.text: {actor} knows the rite: a vigil for a captain who swore never to leave his gold. You go on forewarned, and steadier for it.

outcome.text: You pinch them out one by one. The sea goes very quiet, and a chill settles on everyone.
You give the candles a wide berth.

start.text: The tidal channel that splits the strand is filling fast. On the far side the cave climbs dry; on this side the water will soon be at your chests.

fail.text: The current takes {actor} off their feet and rolls them over the stones, and you turn back.

partial.text: You cross, soaked and chilled.

success.text: {actor} finds the shallows, and you cross in a line before the water rises.

outcome.text: The long way round over sharp rocks wears everyone out.

start.text: In a side cave the rock glows violet. In the middle of the light sits something small and pale with too many legs, humming to itself.

fail.text: It stings {actor} and scuttles into a crack. The hand swells and burns, and you go back.

partial.text: {actor} snatches a shed shell as it flees. It still glows.

success.text: {actor} cups it gently. It sheds its glowing shell like a coat and runs. The shell is worth keeping.

fail.text: The humming gets into {actor}'s head and will not leave. You lead them out, dazed.

partial.text: It is a tide-sprite, harmless. Probably.

success.text: {actor} recognises a tide-sprite, a lucky sign for sailors, and leaves it a crumb. It hums happily.

outcome.text: You back out of the violet light. The humming follows you a while.

start.text: Up the stream, a heap of picked bones and stones makes a nest beside a clutch of pale eggs. The mother is home: a long shore-drake, scaled like wet slate, lifting its head to hiss.

fail.text: A stone clatters. She is on {actor} in two strides, and you drag them out of reach and run.

partial.text: She hears you late and snaps at the last of you.

success.text: You wade past in the stream while she sleeps on her eggs.

fail.text: She fights for her eggs like a fury and drives you all out of the cave, bleeding.

partial.text: She dies hard, raking {actor}.

success.text: {actor} gets a blade under her jaw, and she is still.

options.label: Drive her off with fire (1 fuel)

fail.text: She is not afraid of fire. She is afraid for her eggs, and she drives you off.

partial.text: She backs into the stream, hissing, while you edge past.

success.text: {actor} waves the brand, and she retreats into the water and watches you go.

start.text: On the ledge, among spilled coin and salt-crusted chests, an upright box stands like a coffin. Its lid falls open. The captain steps out, grey and dripping, his cutlass in his hand and his eyes two drowned lights.

fail.text: His cutlass and the cold of the deep follow every blow, and {actor} bleeds for it.

partial.text: Blade rings on blade along the ledge, and nobody gives ground.

success.text: {actor} beats aside his cutlass and drives him back among his chests.

options.label: Claim to be his new crew
options.description: He swore no one but his crew would have his gold. Fail, and you are open.

fail.text: "Liars." He laughs like a gurgling drain and cuts at {actor}.

partial.text: He squints at you, his blade still up.

success.text: "Crew?" He hesitates, half believing, and his blade dips.

options.label: Speak the sailors' rite
options.description: Easier, but the deep answers too, and its cold costs you all.

fail.text: He has no wish to go back to the water. The cold of the deep pours off him.

partial.text: He wavers, and the sea-cold bites as he does.

success.text: {actor} speaks the rite. He turns to look at the sea, and the cold of it washes over you all.

win.text: The captain falls in a heap of wet rags among his chests, and the drowned lights go out of his eyes.

lose.text: His cutlass and the cold of the deep drive you back along the roots and down the beach. He does not leave his gold.

start.text: The gallery is lined with stone coffins. In a side alcove a star of bronze is set into the floor, and the walls around it are pocked with tiny holes.

fail.text: {actor} presses the wrong stone. Darts hiss from the walls, and you retreat, bleeding.

partial.text: {actor} jams most of the holes. One dart still finds a leg.

success.text: {actor} finds the trigger plates and wedges them, and you cross the gallery untouched.

fail.text: Every plate clicks. The darts sting everyone, and you fall back out of the crypt.

partial.text: {actor} sets off one volley, and takes it.

success.text: You cross in a line, stepping only where {actor} steps, and nothing fires.

start.text: Stone grinds on stone down the whole gallery. Coffin lids slide aside, and the crypt's guardians sit up, armoured skeletons with rusted swords.

fail.text: They come from both sides, and you are forced back up the stair.

partial.text: {actor} takes the brunt while the rest shatter them.

success.text: You form a line, and {actor} smashes through them before they are out of their coffins.

fail.text: {actor} gets a sword in the side for their trouble. You retreat.

partial.text: You pin most of them in their coffins, and fight the rest.

success.text: {actor} drops the lids back on their heads, and you wedge them shut.

start.text: In a chamber off the narrow passage, an offering table holds a bronze bowl. Coins of many ages lie in it, and a little star of silver.

outcome.text: Your coins ring in the bowl, and the crypt seems to let out a long breath. You go on lighter of heart.

options.label: Take the silver star
options.description: Robbing the dead is never quite safe.

fail.text: The moment the star leaves the bowl, {actor} is struck by a cold that does not lift. You drop it and flee the crypt.

partial.text: {actor} swaps the star for a stone. The cold still touches them.

success.text: {actor} lifts the star without disturbing a coin.

outcome.text: You leave the bowl as you found it.

start.text: Four round shafts open in the floor of this hall, breathing cold air. As you step in, the flagstones tilt a finger's width toward the nearest pit.

fail.text: A slab tips under {actor}, who slides to the lip and is dragged back torn. You turn back.

partial.text: You cross with a fall or two and some bruises.

success.text: {actor} finds the firm stones, and you cross on them.

fail.text: It takes hours, and the floor tips in the end anyway. You climb back out.

partial.text: Slow, careful work. You are tired but whole at the far side.

success.text: {actor} reads the joints in the floor and walks you over on the pinned slabs.

fail.text: The rope saves a life and is lost to the pit, along with some skin. You go no further.

partial.text: The rope holds when a slab tips. It is frayed through by the end.

success.text: You cross roped together. The rope wears through on the pit's lip, but no one falls.

start.text: Grey hands come over the lips of the shafts, then grey faces, wide-mouthed and hungry. The ghouls that live in the pits have smelled warm meat.

fail.text: Their claws numb whoever they touch. You are driven out, stiff and bleeding.

partial.text: You beat them back down the shafts, clawed.

success.text: {actor} kicks the first back down its pit, and the others think better of it.

options.label: Hurl fire down the shafts (1 alchemicals)

fail.text: One flask misses its shaft, and the ghouls come up it onto {actor}. You flee.

partial.text: The fire drives most of them down screaming.

success.text: Fire roars up from the shafts, and the ghouls do not come up again.

start.text: A chapel ringed by sarcophagi in their alcoves, with a great star sigil inlaid in the centre of the floor. The air above it shimmers. The north wall has caved in.

fail.text: The ward bites back, and the light burns everyone and drives you back up the stair.

partial.text: {actor} dims the sigil long enough to pass, singed.

success.text: {actor} unpicks the ward and keeps a sliver of its silver for later.

fail.text: {actor} brushes the star, and it flares. The blast throws you all back.

partial.text: You get round with only a flicker of pain.

success.text: You circle it along the alcoves without touching the light.

start.text: On the half-moon dais, the lids of the twin sarcophagi lift together. The star-priest rises in robes sewn with silver, a cold light in his eyes, and the floor sigils flare at his feet.

fail.text: His touch drains the warmth out of {actor}.

partial.text: You trade blows on the dais, and the sigils scorch your feet.

success.text: {actor} is on the dais before his first word, and drives him back against his tomb.

options.label: Break the sigils that feed him
options.description: Without the sigils he is only bones. Fail, and they burn you.

fail.text: The sigils blaze, and {actor} is thrown across the vault.

partial.text: A sigil cracks, and mends again.

success.text: {actor} cracks a sigil. His light gutters like a candle in a draught.

options.label: Ward the dais (1 arcana)
options.description: Easier, and the warding is spent either way.

fail.text: The ward breaks, and he comes through it.

partial.text: The ward slows him, and his light still finds you.

success.text: He beats against the ward while you strike at him through it.

options.label: Raise a holy relic (1 relics)
options.description: A sure blow, once. The relic is spent.

outcome.text: His cold light breaks on the relic like water on a rock. He shrinks back into his tomb, and the relic crumbles to dust in your hand.

win.text: The star-priest falls back into his sarcophagus, the silver on his robes gone dull. The sigils on the floor go dark.

lose.text: His cold light and the burning sigils drive you from the dais and back out of the vault. He watches you go.

start.text: A lantern still burns in this nook of sand, beside a huge broken anchor half-buried in it. Bones and belongings lie scattered round it: a boot, a comb, a ship's medicine chest with its lid torn off.

fail.text: {actor} turns a skull over, and a sea-snake curled inside it bites. You turn back.

partial.text: The bones are crushed, not cut. Something big.

success.text: {actor} finds the marks of huge pincers, and salvages the chest's last bandages.

fail.text: A sea-snake in a boot bites {actor}. The poison aches for hours, and you go no deeper.

partial.text: A few coins and a tarnished locket.

success.text: {actor} finds a purse, a locket and a flask of good spirits.

outcome.text: You step round the bones and go on.

start.text: Among the torn lean-tos and cold fire pits, a wasted sailor sits hugging his knees. He has been here a long time. "She comes up from the pool," he whispers. "She comes for the eggs."

options.label: Calm him and ask about her

fail.text: He screams and flails, and his cries wake the grotto. You flee with him, {actor} bleeding from the nose.

partial.text: He tells you she is armoured, and hates fire. Then he will not speak again.

success.text: {actor} gets the whole story: the pool, the cracked egg at its head, and how she hates fire. You go on knowing what you face.

options.label: Share your food with him (2 food)

outcome.text: He eats like a starving man, weeps, and tells you everything he knows. It is worth the food.
You leave him rocking among the tents.

start.text: The lean-tos stir. The crew who waited here come out of them, swollen and grey, sand in their hair, still holding the oars and knives they died with.

fail.text: There are more of them than tents. You are driven back, battered.

partial.text: {actor} holds the middle while the rest finish them.

success.text: {actor} cuts a path through, and the rest fall like wet sacks.

fail.text: The canvas is damp. The fire smokes, and they come through it and drive you out.

partial.text: The fire catches. The few that come through it are easy.

success.text: The lean-tos go up like torches, and the drowned burn with them.

start.text: The lagoon is lit from within by heaps of round golden pods, piled on the shallows like eggs or barnacles. They pulse faintly, all together, like a slow heartbeat.

fail.text: A pod bursts in {actor}'s face. The spores burn the throat and the eyes, and you stagger back out.

partial.text: {actor} gets two pods free and sealed before a third splits.

success.text: {actor} cuts and seals three pods. An alchemist would pay well for them.

fail.text: The pods pulse faster as you pass, and one bursts against {actor}. You turn back.

partial.text: You pass, though the pulse quickens behind you.

success.text: You slip through the shallows, and the pods never change their beat.

start.text: A pod splits, then a dozen. Things like pale crabs with soft shells spill out of them, and come skittering across the shallows by the hundred.

fail.text: They swarm up everyone's legs, and you flee the shallows.

partial.text: {actor} crushes them in heaps but is nipped raw.

success.text: {actor} stamps the first wave flat, and the rest turn back into the water.

fail.text: They catch {actor} in the shallows. You drag them back out.

partial.text: You outrun most of them.

success.text: You splash up the far bank before the swarm is fully hatched.

start.text: At the end of a tidal channel lies the skeleton of a whale, its ribs a cage on the sand. Something waxy and grey is lodged in its old gut, and the whole cave smells strange and sweet.

fail.text: The ribs shift, and one pins {actor}. You lever it off and leave.

partial.text: {actor} cuts out a fist-sized piece. Perfumers pay well for this.

success.text: {actor} cuts out the whole lump: ambergris, worth a small fortune to a perfumer.

fail.text: A rib snaps under {actor}, who falls among the bones. You haul them out and turn back.

partial.text: You get over with a few scrapes.

success.text: You go over the ribs like a ladder.

start.text: Lanterns burn in niches down a carved stair to a still black pool. At its head, something glows through a web of cracks. The pool heaves, and the brood-mother rises: armoured like a crab, long as a boat, feelers trailing from her mouth.

fail.text: Her claw closes on {actor}, and her feelers numb what it does not crush.

partial.text: You crack her shell, and pay for every blow.

success.text: {actor} gets under her claws and drives a blade into a joint of her shell.

options.label: Threaten the glowing egg
options.description: She will do anything for the egg. Almost anything.

fail.text: She does not bargain. She charges the one at the egg.

partial.text: She hesitates, then comes on.

success.text: {actor} holds a blade to the egg. She freezes, torn between you and her brood.

options.label: Burn her with alchemist's fire (1 alchemicals)
options.description: She hates fire. The flask is spent either way.

fail.text: The flask bursts on the stair. She comes through the flames.

partial.text: The fire drives her half back into the pool, and she lashes out as she goes.

success.text: The flask bursts on her shell. She thrashes in the water, smoking.

win.text: The brood-mother sinks back into the black pool, and does not come up again. The egg glows on alone.

lose.text: Her claws and feelers drive you back up the carved stair and out of the grottoes. The lanterns burn on behind you.

start.text: A soldier stands in the knee-deep water at the foot of the stair, spear grounded, as grey and clear as the water. "Halt," he says, in a voice like wind in a well. "The word."

options.label: Give him a watchword
options.description: Guess well and he lets you by. Guess badly and he attacks.

fail.text: "Wrong." His spear passes through {actor}'s armour like cold through cloth.

partial.text: He frowns, then waves you on, and the cold of his passing makes you shiver.

success.text: {actor} gives a word with the right weight to it. The sentry salutes and fades.

fail.text: {actor} recalls the wrong kingdom. He levels his spear.

partial.text: Close enough. He stands aside, slowly.

success.text: {actor} names the old king and his watchword. The sentry weeps, and is gone.

fail.text: His spear is cold as winter. You fall back out of the keep, numbed.

partial.text: {actor} takes his spear in the shoulder and breaks him apart.

success.text: {actor} sweeps through him, and he blows apart like mist.

start.text: Stones have fallen from the guardroom's vault, and as you wade in, the rest groans. Water drips from a crack that is widening as you watch.

fail.text: The vault comes down ahead of you, and a stone catches {actor}. The way is blocked.

partial.text: You make it through a rain of grit and small stones.

success.text: You are through and up the stair before the first stone falls.

fail.text: The prop slips. The crack opens over {actor}, and you pull them out and turn back.

partial.text: It takes hours, but the vault holds while you pass.

success.text: {actor} wedges the crack with a fallen beam, and you pass in safety.

start.text: The hall of four pillars is flooded to the waist. Ripples move where nothing is moving, and then grey hands close round your ankles: the drowned of the keep, pulling you down.

fail.text: They drag {actor} under twice before you haul them back out, half-drowned.

partial.text: You tear free and stagger across, bruised by grips you cannot see.

success.text: {actor} wades like a bull, and drags the others along in their wake.

fail.text: {actor} slips from a capital into the water, and the hands are waiting. You pull them free and retreat.

partial.text: You swing pillar to pillar. Someone gets a foot wet, and a hand finds it.

success.text: You cross from pillar to pillar, and the hands grasp at nothing.

start.text: Pale, cold light fills the long chapel, as if the moon were shining in a place it never could. Rows of ghosts kneel in it, praying silently toward the apse.

options.label: Kneel and pray with them
options.description: A shared prayer might help them, and you. It takes from you if it goes wrong.

fail.text: The prayer is not for the living. It drinks the warmth out of you, and you flee the chapel.

partial.text: You pray beside them a while, and they let you go.

success.text: {actor} leads the prayer to its end. The ghosts rise, bow and go out like candles, and the light that is left mends you.

fail.text: A ghost turns its head at {actor}'s step. Its stare is like a knife of ice, and you back out.

partial.text: You pass, though one of them watches you all the way.

success.text: You pass behind them, quiet as the dead.

start.text: In the alcove behind the high hall, weapon racks still stand, most of their blades rusted to lace. A few are wrapped in oiled cloth, and the rack they hang on leans out over the water.

fail.text: The rack comes down, and {actor} under it. You dig them out and leave.

partial.text: {actor} saves two blades before the rack groans and falls.

success.text: {actor} lifts the rack's whole wrapped bundle down. Old steel, still good.

outcome.text: You leave the racks to rust.

start.text: Spectral knights drill in the high hall, turning and thrusting in silence. As you step in, every helm swings toward you, and they lower their swords as one.

fail.text: Their blades cut cold and deep, and drive you out of the hall.

partial.text: You break their line with wounds to show for it.

success.text: {actor} breaks their captain, and the rest fade with him.

fail.text: Your salute is a mockery to them. They charge, and you run.

partial.text: They hesitate, then return the salute stiffly and fade.

success.text: {actor} salutes in the old style. The knights return it, sheathe their swords and fade.

start.text: Two pillars stand in green water in the great hall. Its east wall has burst open on the roar of an underground river. Out of the water rises the castellan in rusted plate, river-weed hanging from his crown, and a cold light burns in his helm.

fail.text: His gauntlet finds {actor}, and the cold of it goes to the bone.

partial.text: Steel rings between the pillars, and the river-cold drains you all.

success.text: {actor} smashes his helm aside, and the light in it flickers.

options.label: Give him to the river
options.description: The keep drowned; he never let it go. Fail, and you are open.

fail.text: He will not go. His gauntlet closes on {actor}.

partial.text: He looks to the breach, then back at you.

success.text: {actor} speaks the rites for those lost to water. He turns toward the river, and for a breath forgets you.

options.label: Seal him in a circle (1 arcana)
options.description: Easier, and the warding is spent either way.

fail.text: The circle cracks under him, and he comes through it.

partial.text: The circle slows him, no more.

success.text: He stands bound and raging, and you strike at him in his circle.

options.label: Call him to his duty
options.description: A long shot. If he listens, you get your breath back.

fail.text: He hears only a stranger in his hall, and cuts at the voice.

partial.text: He pauses, but does not lower his sword.

success.text: {actor} speaks to him as his liege. He lowers his sword and stares at the breach, and you catch your breath while he remembers.

win.text: The light goes out of the castellan's helm. He sinks back into the green water, and the river takes him at last.

lose.text: Cold to the bone, you are driven back from the breach and out of the keep. He lets you go, and stands guard in the water.

start.text: Rain hammers the doors behind you. In the dark vestibule the carved guardians on either side of the red runner turn their stone heads, and step down from their plinths.

fail.text: Stone fists are hard on flesh. You retreat, aching.

partial.text: {actor} takes a stone fist and breaks the statue that threw it.

success.text: {actor} topples the first into the second, and both shatter.

options.label: Slip past them up the stair

fail.text: A stone hand closes on {actor}'s ankle. You tear them loose and run.

partial.text: You get past, one of you clubbed on the way.

success.text: You are up the stair while they still turn, and they will not leave their posts.

start.text: A pale man in old livery waits on the stair with a candle. "Guests," he says, smiling with too many teeth. "My lady is expecting you. This way, please."

fail.text: He sees through you, and his smile opens wider than a mouth should. You flee the manor.

partial.text: He leads you on, suspicious, and you take your chance to slip away.

success.text: {actor} plays the part, and he leads you past the traps of the house before he goes to announce you.

fail.text: He is quicker than any servant. His teeth find {actor}'s throat, and you drag them out of the house.

partial.text: He dies hissing, and claws {actor} on the way down.

success.text: {actor} strikes before the smile finishes, and he crumbles to ash.

start.text: A long table on a red cloth is crowded with flasks, alembics and bottled things that float in cloudy liquid. Some of the bottles are labelled; some of the labels are names.

options.label: Sort out what is worth taking

fail.text: A flask cracks in {actor}'s hand and the fumes fill the room. You flee, choking.

partial.text: {actor} pockets a few reagents before the fumes drive you out.

success.text: {actor} picks out the useful reagents and leaves the rest well alone.

options.label: Smash it all
options.description: Better that no one uses this again.

fail.text: The glass breaks and the bottled things writhe on the floor, and one of them bites. You get out.

partial.text: It all goes to pieces with a hiss of fumes.

success.text: You sweep the table clean, and nothing of the lady's work survives.

outcome.text: You leave the bottles to their floating.

start.text: The great hearth is carved as a snarling face, and a fire burns in its mouth with no wood to feed it. As you come near, the stone lips move. "Give," it says, "and I will warm you. Refuse, and I will burn you."

outcome.text: It swallows the coins with a roar, and the warmth that rolls out of it mends you.
It screams as the water hits, and dies to steam. The hall goes cold and quiet.

fail.text: A gout of flame catches {actor}, and you pull back.

partial.text: It spits fire as you pass, and someone is singed.

success.text: You hurry past before it can draw breath.

start.text: Across the covered bridge, a long hall ringed by a pillared gallery. Crates are piled around a sheet-draped shape, and a barred cell stands in the corner. A girl in a torn nightdress is inside it. "Please," she says. "Before she comes back."

fail.text: The lock is trapped. A needle drives into {actor}'s hand, and the poison sends you back.

partial.text: It opens on the third try. She runs without a word.

success.text: {actor} has her out in a moment. She presses a vial into their hand: "I stole it from her."

fail.text: She is not what she seems. She strikes through the bars with long nails, and you flee the cellar.

partial.text: You cannot tell if she is a prisoner or something worse. You leave her there.

success.text: {actor} sees the hunger behind her eyes: the lady's daughter, kept for a reason. You leave her caged, forewarned.

start.text: The sheet slides off the shape on the crates: an altar heaped with offerings. The household gathers from the gallery, servants and guests with burning eyes and knives, chanting the idol's name.

fail.text: There are many of them, and they do not care if they die. You are driven out, cut deep.

partial.text: You break them, and some of their knives find you.

success.text: {actor} fells the chanter, and the rest flee into the storm.

fail.text: The crates tumble the wrong way, onto {actor}. The cult closes in, and you run.

partial.text: Half of them go down under the crates. You fight the rest.

success.text: {actor} heaves the stack over, and the household is buried under its own offerings.

start.text: In the round apse a great horned idol glows like a furnace in a sunken ring, hung about with chains. The lady of the house stands before it, arms wide. Fire runs down the chains toward her, and her eyes catch light.

fail.text: The idol's fire runs through her into {actor}.

partial.text: You trade blows in a storm of sparks.

success.text: {actor} reaches her before the fire does, and she reels back toward the ring.

options.label: Break the chains
options.description: Easier, but the chains burn whoever grips them.

fail.text: The chains are red-hot and will not break. {actor}'s hands burn.

partial.text: A link gives a little, and the iron sears {actor}'s palms.

success.text: {actor} wrenches a chain loose, hands smoking, and the idol lurches in its ring.

options.label: Call her back to herself
options.description: The lady may still be in there. Fail, and you are open.

fail.text: She hears only the idol. Fire leaps from her hands to {actor}.

partial.text: Her eyes flicker, and fill with fire again.

success.text: {actor} calls her by her own name. Her eyes clear for a breath, and the fire runs back up the chains.

options.label: Banish its fire (1 arcana)
options.description: A sure blow, once. The arcana is spent.

outcome.text: The banishing takes. The idol's fire sinks to embers, and the lady staggers, only a woman for a moment.

win.text: The idol topples into its own fire and the chains fall slack. The lady falls with it, and the apse goes dark.

lose.text: The idol's fire throws you down the stair and out of the manor, scorched black. Its glow still burns in the windows.

start.text: A path of stepping stones runs through black water toward the great carved skull, between tusks and ribs that stick up out of the mire. The water smokes where it touches bone.

fail.text: {actor} slips, and the black water eats at their legs. You turn back.

partial.text: A foot goes in, briefly. It is enough to burn.

success.text: {actor} finds the dry stones, and you all cross in their steps.

fail.text: Slow, and the fumes still get into everyone. You give up and go back.

partial.text: Slow and safe, and the fumes leave you tired.

success.text: {actor} finds the hidden ledge under the water, and you walk it dry-shod.

start.text: Lizardfolk rise out of the reeds on both sides of the causeway, painted black, their spears tipped with dragon-scale. They hiss their master's name.

fail.text: They come from both sides and drive you back into the mire, bleeding.

partial.text: {actor} holds the narrow way, and pays for it.

success.text: {actor} spears the first, and the rest sink back into the reeds.

options.label: Cow them with the dragon's name

fail.text: They laugh at you, in their way, and close in. You run.

partial.text: Some of them back off. The rest fight half-heartedly.

success.text: {actor} roars that you come with the dragon's blessing, and they fall back bowing.

start.text: On a grassy hummock heaped with the bones of great beasts, a rune-carved pillar has toppled and is slowly sinking into the mud. The runes still glow faintly green.

fail.text: The runes are a curse, and {actor} reads it aloud. You flee the stones.

partial.text: {actor} makes out the dragon's name, and that it hates the light.

success.text: {actor} reads the dragon's true name, and the old warding words carved against it.

fail.text: A great jawbone shifts and closes on {actor}'s arm like a trap. You pry it open and leave.

partial.text: Among the bones, a few coins from some would-be thief.

success.text: {actor} finds a dead thief's pouch: coin and two good stones.

start.text: The bones on the hummock are fresh. Two great crocodiles slide out of the shallows and come at you, low and fast.

fail.text: One gets its jaws round {actor} and rolls. You drag them free and flee.

partial.text: You kill them both, but not before they bite.

success.text: {actor} drives a blade into the first one's eye, and the other flees.

fail.text: {actor} is too slow up the bank, and the jaws close on a leg. You pull them free and go back.

partial.text: You scramble up and wait them out, bruised.

success.text: You are up on the pillar in a moment. The crocodiles give up and sink away.

start.text: The causeway ends at the giant skull's jaw. Its stone teeth drip with slime, and a dark gap between them leads in. Bones of beasts that tried it lie under the teeth.

fail.text: The teeth slam down. {actor} is caught by the leg, and you pry them free and turn back.

partial.text: The jaw closes behind the last of you, scraping someone.

success.text: {actor} spots the pressure plate, and you step over it and through.

fail.text: The slime is slick. {actor} falls onto the teeth, and you haul them off and turn back.

partial.text: A long, slow climb, and you reach the top exhausted.

success.text: You climb the brow, and look down on the lair from above.

start.text: On the skull's brow, a golden sigil burns in a ring of carved stone. The bones of two would-be thieves lie beside it. The air hums, and your skin crawls.

fail.text: The sigil bursts with light. Everyone is burned and thrown back.

partial.text: {actor} dims it enough to pass, scorched.

success.text: {actor} unpicks the sigil, and pockets a sliver of its gold.

outcome.text: It drinks from you as you pass. You go on, weaker.

options.label: Smother it with a counter-ward (1 arcana)

outcome.text: The counter-ward chokes the sigil, and you pass in the dark.

start.text: Behind the skull, between two carved pillars, a cave opens in the rock. The air stings your eyes. Out of it slides the dragon, black as a peat pool, acid smoking from its jaws.

fail.text: Its jaws close on {actor}, and the acid in them burns.

partial.text: You trade blows with it between the pillars, and its acid spatters you all.

success.text: {actor} gets under its jaws and opens a long cut in its belly.

options.label: Strike from the shadows
options.description: A blow from where it does not expect one. Fail, and you are open.

fail.text: It smells {actor}, and finds them first.

partial.text: It sniffs the air, and turns away again.

success.text: {actor} is on it from the dark before it knows where you are. It rears back, blind on one side.

options.label: Blind it with alchemist's fire (1 alchemicals)
options.description: Easier, and the flask is spent either way.

fail.text: The flask breaks on the pillar, and it breathes through the smoke.

partial.text: The fire blinds it a breath or two, and it thrashes into you.

success.text: The flask bursts in its eyes, and you hack at it while it thrashes.

options.label: Find the clean air
options.description: A long shot. If the wind is with you, you breathe again.

fail.text: {actor} misreads the wind, and its breath rolls over everyone.

partial.text: The wind turns, and turns back.

success.text: {actor} finds the wind. Its breath blows back in its own face, and you get your breath back.

win.text: The black dragon slumps between the pillars, acid hissing out of its jaws into the peat. The mire goes quiet.

lose.text: Its acid breath drives you back past the skull and out into the reeds, burned raw. It does not leave its cave.

start.text: Round stone chambers are strung over a gulf of smoke on short bridges. Red cracks glow far below, and the fumes that rise make the eyes stream and the head swim.

options.label: Hold your breath and run it

fail.text: The fumes drop {actor} on a bridge. You drag them back, choking.

partial.text: You reach the far chamber retching.

success.text: You run chamber to chamber, breathing only in the clear pockets {actor} finds.

outcome.text: You soak your scarves and go slowly, and the fumes cannot touch you.

start.text: Something hoots in the smoke. A troop of great grey apes, wearing gold collars, comes swinging along the bridges toward you, teeth bared.

fail.text: One hurls {actor} against a wall, and the troop drives you out.

partial.text: You throw them off the bridges one by one, mauled.

success.text: {actor} beats down the leader, and the troop scatters into the smoke.

fail.text: They take the food and come on anyway, and you run.

partial.text: Most of them squabble over the food. A few still come.

success.text: {actor} scatters the food, and the apes sit down to eat it and let you by.

fail.text: The leader takes it as a challenge, and answers it. You flee the vault.

partial.text: The leader blinks first, but some of the troop do not.

success.text: {actor} holds the leader's eye until it looks away. The troop parts for you.

start.text: At the top of the long stair, a hall lit gold by braziers. Four round pedestals stand around a lidded altar, each carved with a different ape: one covering its eyes, one its ears, one its mouth, one beating its chest.

fail.text: The wrong pedestal sinks. The braziers spit fire across the hall, and you flee it.

partial.text: {actor} gets it right on the second try, singed.

success.text: {actor} presses them in the order of the old proverb. The altar lid slides, and there is an offering inside.

fail.text: The braziers roar the moment the lid shifts, and you are driven back.

partial.text: {actor} heaves it open through a gout of flame.

success.text: {actor} slides the lid before the braziers catch on.

outcome.text: You climb on past the braziers.

start.text: Three great stone balls sit heaped in a corner of this narrow room, and grooves worn in the floor run from them to the door. As you step in, something clicks.

fail.text: A ball catches {actor} against the wall. You turn back.

partial.text: You make it, one of you clipped.

success.text: You are through the far door as the first ball thunders past.

fail.text: {actor} reads the grooves wrong and the balls come straight at you. You flee back the way you came.

partial.text: Two balls take the grooves. The third has to be dodged.

success.text: {actor} kicks the right stone, and the balls roll harmlessly along their grooves.

fail.text: The wedges slip. You dive aside, the irons are lost, and you go back.

partial.text: The wedges hold long enough.

success.text: The irons hold, and the balls never move.

start.text: Beyond a long hall of alcoves, a room whose floor is studded with stone knobs in a pattern like a game board. Darts lie scattered among them, and a skeleton in a broken mail shirt.

fail.text: {actor} steps on the wrong knob. Darts fly from every wall, and you retreat.

partial.text: {actor} finds the pattern on the second try.

success.text: {actor} sees the pattern: an ape's path through the trees. You walk it without a dart fired.

fail.text: Every step is wrong. The darts sting you all, and you go back.

partial.text: {actor} takes a dart or two and makes it across.

success.text: You dance across before the darts can find you.

start.text: An eight-sided chamber around a well of cold blue light. As you step in, the great stone ape carved on the well's rim uncurls, taller than three men, and the blue light burns in its eyes. "Who comes to the King's well?"

fail.text: A stone fist like a falling wall catches {actor}.

partial.text: You chip at it, and it swats you round the well.

success.text: {actor} cracks a stone knee, and it staggers on the rim.

options.label: Answer it as the King would
options.description: It wants an answer as much as a fight. A bad answer leaves you open.

fail.text: Wrong. It swats {actor} across the chamber.

partial.text: It is not satisfied, but it is not sure.

success.text: {actor} answers as a king would: proud, and with a jest. The ape laughs, and drops its guard.

options.label: Dim the well's light
options.description: Easier: the well feeds it. Its cold costs you all every time.

fail.text: The blue light bites back, and {actor} is thrown from the rim.

partial.text: The light dims, and the cold of it goes through you all.

success.text: {actor} draws the light down. The ape slows, and the cold of the well goes through you all.

options.label: Lay a gem in its hand (1 gems)
options.description: Tribute for the King. A sure blow, once.

outcome.text: It closes its fist on the gem and turns it in the blue light, and for a long moment forgets you are there.

win.text: The stone ape topples into its own well, and the blue light gutters out of its eyes. The King's well is yours.

lose.text: Its stone fists drive you back out of the eight-sided chamber and out of the vault, broken and bleeding. It curls up on the rim again.

start.text: An old stone bridge once crossed the stream here. Its arches have tumbled into the water and roots strangle what is left. The stream runs fast and green.

fail.text: A stone rolls under {actor}, who goes into the stream and is battered down it, back the way you came.

partial.text: You cross, wet and scraped.

success.text: {actor} finds the firm stones and hauls the rest across.

fail.text: The current is stronger than it looked. You lose time and strength, and give up the crossing.

partial.text: A long way round, and cold.

success.text: {actor} finds a gravel ford, and you are over dry to the waist.

start.text: Rangers step out of the green on the far bank, bows drawn, faces slack and eyes shining green. The dragon has had them a long time. "Turn back," they say together.

fail.text: Their arrows find you from every side, and you never close. You fall back into the forest.

partial.text: You cross under their arrows and put them down.

success.text: {actor} is among them before they loose twice.

fail.text: The charm holds, and they loose at {actor}.

partial.text: Some of them wake, weeping. The rest you must fight.

success.text: {actor} breaks the charm. They wake, ashamed and grateful, and tell you where she sleeps.

fail.text: They see you at once. Arrows hiss into the water around {actor}, and you fall back.

partial.text: You get past, one of you with an arrow in the pack.

success.text: You slide past under the overhanging roots, and they never see you.

start.text: A great roofless building stands beside the stream, its walls falling outward and moss over the floor. A green mist hangs in it, sweet and choking. Dead birds lie in the moss.

fail.text: The mist burns {actor}'s lungs. They stumble back out coughing blood.

partial.text: You come through choking.

success.text: You are through it before it gets into your lungs.

outcome.text: The bitter herbs keep the poison out, and you walk through unharmed.

fail.text: The thorns are poisoned too, and you turn back.

partial.text: A long, scratching way round.

success.text: {actor} finds a deer path round the ruin.

start.text: Webs as thick as sails fill the ruined walls. Spiders the size of ponies drop from the canopy, their legs drumming on the moss.

fail.text: Their bites burn with poison. You flee, sick and shaking.

partial.text: You hack them down, bitten.

success.text: {actor} cuts the first in two, and the rest flee into the trees.

fail.text: The webs are damp and smoke. The spiders come through and drive you back.

partial.text: The webs go up, and with them most of the spiders.

success.text: The webs go up like dry straw, and the spiders burn with them.

start.text: An old tower fell across the bank long ago, and lies like a ramp of broken stone up into the canopy. From the top you might see the whole way to the falls.

fail.text: The stone crumbles. {actor} falls through the canopy, and you turn back to tend them.

partial.text: {actor} sees the falls and the pool above, and nothing more.

success.text: {actor} sees the dragon's path worn through the trees, and where she lies in the pool.

outcome.text: You leave the tower to the vines and follow the stream.

start.text: The stream pours over a stone lip from the pool above in a white curtain of water. To each side, old stairs climb through the trees, half fallen.

fail.text: The rock is slick. {actor} falls the height of three men, and you give up the climb.

partial.text: You get up, battered by the falling water.

success.text: {actor} climbs the wet rock like a ladder and drops a rope for the rest.

outcome.text: The fallen stairs take you hours, climbing over and round. You arrive spent.

start.text: A wide green pool cupped in tiers of ancient stone, dead branches sunk in it and mist glittering in the light. The water bulges, and the wyrm rises: green as old copper, vast and ancient, poison curling from her teeth. "Little things," she says. "You have come so far."

fail.text: Her teeth find {actor}, and her poison follows.

partial.text: You fight her in the shallows, and her poison breath curls round you all.

success.text: {actor} gets under her jaw and drives a blade between her scales.

options.label: Flatter her, and strike while she preens
options.description: Green dragons love to be admired. They hate to be lied to.

fail.text: She sees the lie and laughs, and breathes on {actor}.

partial.text: She listens, and does not believe a word.

success.text: {actor} praises her till she lifts her chin, and her throat is bare.

options.label: Drink antidotes and charge (1 healing)
options.description: Easier, and the healing is spent either way.

fail.text: The antidote blunts the poison, but her teeth are just as sharp.

partial.text: Her breath washes over you, and you close the distance coughing.

success.text: You charge through her breath and cut at her in the shallows.

options.label: Read her old name off the tiers
options.description: A long shot. Names have power, and old ones most of all.

fail.text: {actor} speaks the wrong name. She is not amused.

partial.text: The carvings are too worn to read.

success.text: {actor} reads her old name off the carved stone and speaks it aloud. She flinches, and you take heart.

win.text: The green wyrm sinks dead into her pool, and the poison mist thins over the falls. The tiers go quiet.

lose.text: Her poison breath drives you back down the falls, barely breathing. "Come again, little things," she calls after you.

start.text: Sofas and chairs stand under grey dust sheets, and someone has lit the candles in the sconces. Then the sheets rise off the furniture, empty, and drift toward you with their hems dragging.

fail.text: A sheet wraps {actor}'s head and pulls tight. You tear them free, choking, and flee back to the vestibule.

partial.text: You slash the sheets to rags, but not before they have smothered and bruised you all.

success.text: {actor} cuts the first in two, and the rest fall limp over the chairs.

options.label: Go round by the garden window

fail.text: The sheets follow you to the window and pin {actor} against the glass. You break free and fall back to the vestibule.

partial.text: You climb out into the rain and in again by the next window, soaked and chilled.

success.text: {actor} eases you out and back in further along. The sheets settle behind you.

options.label: Set them alight with lamp oil
options.description: Uses 1 fuel.

outcome.text: The sheets go up like dry leaves and fly burning round the room. You beat the sparks out of your cloaks and go on.

start.text: In the west rooms a lord in a sodden coat sits at the writing desk, water dripping from his hair onto the page. He doesn't look up. 'She gave the fire my name,' he says. 'Everything she has, she bought with mine.'

options.label: Read her letters over his shoulder

fail.text: {actor} leans in, and the drowned lord turns. Cold water fills their mouth. You drag them out of the wing, coughing.

partial.text: You read enough to learn that the idol is held by its chains, not by its ring of stone.

success.text: {actor} finds the pact itself among the letters: what the idol was promised, and what breaks it.

fail.text: He looks up, and his grief turns to rage at the living. Icy water floods the room to the knees, and you flee the wing.

partial.text: He weeps, and fades, and leaves his seal ring on the desk. It is worth something.

success.text: He listens, and nods, and presses his seal ring into {actor}'s hand. 'Show it to the fire,' he says, 'and it will remember me.'

options.label: Leave the dead man to his letters

outcome.text: You close the door softly on the scratch of his pen.

start.text: The covered bridge to the gallery hall has lost half its roof. Rain drives through the gap, the stones shiver underfoot, and lightning strikes its iron fittings again and again.

fail.text: Lightning hits the rail as {actor} passes it. You carry them back into the lower house, smoking.

partial.text: You run it with the thunder in your teeth, and a strike close by throws you down at the far end.

success.text: {actor} counts the strikes and calls the run. You are across between one and the next.

fail.text: A gust tears the last of the roof away above {actor}, and a beam comes down. You haul them back to the near end.

partial.text: It is slow, cold, soaking work, but the lightning finds only the rails.

success.text: {actor} finds the line the rain does not reach, and you cross wet but whole.

options.label: Rope yourselves to the far door
options.description: Uses 1 gear.

outcome.text: You throw an iron-hooked line to the far door and cross on it, and leave it behind to draw the lightning.

start.text: The great ring at the west end stands on nothing. As you step onto it the whole floor tilts toward the gulf with a groan of stone, and smoke curls up through the cracks.

fail.text: The floor swings. {actor} slides over the edge and is caught by the rope at the last. You scramble back onto the bridge you came by.

partial.text: You inch round the rim with the floor rocking under you, all the way to the stair.

success.text: {actor} calls each step, and the ring hangs level while you cross.

fail.text: The floor tips sharply under {actor}, and you all slide toward the gulf and claw your way back out the way you came.

partial.text: You run uphill on a tilting floor and leap the last stretch to the stair.

success.text: {actor} reaches the stair first and hauls the others up before the ring swings back.

options.label: Throw your heaviest irons down on the high side
options.description: Uses 1 gear.

outcome.text: A sack of irons thumps onto the high side. The ring settles, and you cross.

start.text: Halfway down the long hall the doors grind shut behind you. Water bursts from the holes in both walls, the trench down the middle overflows, and the level climbs fast toward the ceiling.

options.label: Swim for the far grate and force it

fail.text: The grate will not give. {actor} is half drowned before the doors behind grind open and the water drains, and you stagger back the way you came.

partial.text: The grate gives at the third heave, and the water roars out with you in it.

success.text: {actor} wrenches the grate open, and you ride the water out of the hall.

options.label: Search the alcoves for the release

fail.text: {actor} turns the wrong carving, and the spouts gush harder. You beat on the doors until they open, and fall back half drowned.

partial.text: You find it with the water at your chins. The spouts stop, and the hall drains slowly.

success.text: {actor} finds a carved ape's hand in an alcove that turns. The water stops and drains away.

options.label: Hammer timber into the spouts
options.description: Uses 1 timber.

outcome.text: You drive wooden plugs into the nearest spouts, and the rest cannot fill the hall before you have the grate open.
